sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，人们在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女尸。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血液也被放干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 看来凶手煞费苦心地隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为无名氏。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 随后，侦探们终于得知了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是 Casefile Presents 推出的全新系列节目，您现在可以在各大播客平台收听。

sentences.en: Today's episode deals with a crime committed against a child.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目讲述了一起针对儿童的犯罪。

sentences.en: It won't be suitable for all listeners.
sentences.zh: 本集内容并非适合所有听众。

sentences.en: The Teixeira Mendonça family lived in the northern Portuguese town of Lozada,
sentences.zh: 特谢拉·门多萨一家住在葡萄牙北部的洛扎达镇，

sentences.en: 40 kilometres east from the country's striking and sun-baked coastline.
sentences.zh: 距离该国阳光明媚、引人注目的海岸线向东40公里。

sentences.en: Situated in the economically developed Portu district,
sentences.zh: 洛扎达位于经济发达的波尔图区，

sentences.en: Lozada is known for hosting championship motor racing events on a circuit just outside of town.
sentences.zh: 以在镇郊赛道上举办冠军赛车活动而闻名。

sentences.en: It features remnants of its rich ancient history, with heritage monuments and sites including churches, manors, and courts dating back to the Middle Ages.
sentences.zh: 这里保留着丰富的古代历史遗迹，包括可以追溯到中世纪的教堂、庄园和法院等文化古迹和遗址。

sentences.en: Lozada maintains its strong agricultural tradition, with sprawling rural farm and bushland intersected by winding highways that lead to inland municipalities.
sentences.zh: 洛扎达保持着浓厚的农业传统，广阔的乡村农田和灌木丛与通往内陆市镇的蜿蜒公路纵横交错。

sentences.en: The Teixeira Mendonça family, helmed by Patriarch Manuel and his wife,
sentences.zh: 特谢拉·门多萨一家由家长曼努埃尔和他的妻子

sentences.en: Philomena, were well known and regarded within the local community.
sentences.zh: 菲洛梅娜掌管，在当地社区享有很高的声誉和声望。

sentences.en: By the late 90s, the couple had two children, an eight-year-old daughter named Carina, and a son, 11-year-old Uy Pedru.
sentences.zh: 到90年代末，这对夫妇有两个孩子，8岁的女儿名叫卡琳娜，11岁的儿子名叫乌伊·佩德鲁。

sentences.en: Born on January 28, 1987,
sentences.zh: 乌伊·佩德鲁出生于1987年1月28日，

sentences.en: Uy Pedru was an affectionate and happy child who was the life of the party.
sentences.zh: 是一个深情、快乐且充满活力的孩子。

sentences.en: A devoted animal lover, he accumulated a menagerie at home, adopting so many canaries that he was forced to give some to his grandparents.
sentences.zh: 他是一个狂热的动物爱好者，在家中养了许多动物，收养的金丝雀多到不得不送一些给祖父母。

sentences.en: He once brought a squirrel home and made a treehouse for it, though was left devastated when it escaped the next day.
sentences.zh: 他曾带回过一只松鼠并为它搭了一座树屋，不过第二天松鼠逃跑时他伤心欲绝。

sentences.en: When he wasn't caring for animals,
sentences.zh: 除了照顾动物之外，

sentences.en: Uy Pedru loved riding his bicycle, skateboarding, and helping with handiwork and electrical projects at home.
sentences.zh: 乌伊·佩德鲁还喜欢骑自行车、玩滑板，以及帮忙做家里的手工和电路活。

sentences.en: A keen soccer player, he dreamed of playing professionally when he grew up.
sentences.zh: 他是一名热心的足球运动员，梦想着长大后成为一名职业球员。

sentences.en: His life was full of jokes and laughter, with Philomena describing her son's laugh as contagious.
sentences.zh: 他的生活充满了笑话和欢笑，菲洛梅娜形容她儿子的笑声极具感染力。

sentences.en: She admired his imagination, a quality she observed during his long bubble baths and when he attempted to use a fork as a makeshift television antenna.
sentences.zh: 她很欣赏儿子的想象力，这是她在儿子长时间泡泡浴以及他试图用叉子当作临时电视天线时观察到的品质。

sentences.en: Philomena worked at her father's driving school directly opposite the family home, making it convenient for her children to stop by
sentences.zh: 菲洛梅娜在正对家门口她父亲的驾校工作，这让她的孩子们

sentences.en: if they needed to speak with her during office hours.
sentences.zh: 如果在办公时间需要找她，顺便过来会非常方便。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, March 4, 1998, shortly after 2pm,
sentences.zh: 1998年3月4日星期三下午2点刚过，

sentences.en: Philomena was busy working when Uy Pedru arrived.
sentences.zh: 菲洛梅娜正忙着工作，乌伊·佩德鲁到了。

sentences.en: He'd just finished lunch and had cycled over seeking permission to spend the rest of the afternoon taking a car ride with his friend,
sentences.zh: 他刚吃完午饭，骑着自行车过来，想征得同意和他的朋友

sentences.en: Afonso Diash.
sentences.zh: 阿方索·迪亚什一起去兜风消磨剩下的下午时光。

sentences.en: Diash was a 22-year-old truck driver who had become close with Philomena's family after obtaining his driver's license from her school three years earlier.
sentences.zh: 迪亚什是一名22岁的卡车司机，三年前从菲洛梅娜的驾校拿到驾照后，与她家结下了深厚的友谊。

sentences.en: His own family was burdened by financial struggles, which elicited a great deal of sympathy from Philomena.
sentences.zh: 他自己的家庭背负着沉重的经济压力，这引起了菲洛梅娜极大的同情。

sentences.en: She provided Diash with clothes and let him assist at the driving school for extra money.
sentences.zh: 她给迪亚什提供衣服，并让他去驾校帮忙赚点外快。

sentences.en: Diash soon befriended Philomena's children and she trusted him to drive Uy Pedru and Karina to school most days.
sentences.zh: 迪亚什很快就与菲洛梅娜的孩子们成了朋友，她也信任他，大多数日子都让他开车送乌伊·佩德鲁和卡琳娜上学。

sentences.en: Uy Pedru was particularly enthusiastic about his new friend, who seemed cool and exciting to the 11-year-old by virtue of being older.
sentences.zh: 乌伊·佩德鲁对他的这位新朋友格外热情，对于这个11岁的男孩来说，对方因为年长而显得既酷又令人兴奋。

sentences.en: Despite their significant age difference,
sentences.zh: 尽管他们有着显著的年龄差距，

sentences.en: Diash was regarded as childish and immature, which made him relatable to Uy Pedru.
sentences.zh: 但迪亚什被认为有些幼稚和不成熟，这让他和乌伊·佩德鲁很有共同语言。

sentences.en: According to Diash, the two were like brothers.
sentences.zh: 据迪亚什所说，两人就像亲兄弟一样。

sentences.en: Yet, not everyone in the Teixeira-Mendoza household approved of their friendship.
sentences.zh: 然而，特谢拉-门多萨家并不是所有人都赞成他们的友谊。

sentences.en: Uy Pedru's father Manuel and his maternal grandfather Jose were troubled by the 11-year age gap between the two, as well as Diash's habit of smoking cigarettes
sentences.zh: 乌伊·佩德鲁的父亲曼努埃尔和外祖父何塞对两人之间11岁的年龄差，以及迪亚什习惯

sentences.en: in Uy Pedru's company.
sentences.zh: 在乌伊·佩德鲁面前抽烟的行为感到担忧。

sentences.en: Manuel expressed his concerns to his wife on multiple occasions, and although Philomena regarded Diash as harmless, she respected her husband's grievances
sentences.zh: 曼努埃尔曾多次向妻子表达他的担忧，尽管菲洛梅娜认为迪亚什没有恶意，但她尊重丈夫的不满，

sentences.en: and started limiting the time Uy Pedru and Diash spent alone together.
sentences.zh: 并开始限制乌伊·佩德鲁和迪亚什单独相处的时间。

sentences.en: Therefore, she denied her son's request to go driving with Diash that afternoon.
sentences.zh: 因此，她拒绝了儿子那天下午和迪亚什去开车兜风的请求。

sentences.en: Uy Pedru was unhappy about his mother's decision, but ultimately accepted it.
sentences.zh: 乌伊·佩德鲁对母亲的决定很不高兴，但最终还是接受了。

sentences.en: Philomena reminded him that he had a tutoring lesson at 5pm and suggested he play in the vacant field behind her office in the meantime.
sentences.zh: 菲洛梅娜提醒他下午5点还要上家教课，并建议他在此期间去她办公室后面的空地上玩。

sentences.en: The large space was framed by dry grass, trees and shrubs, and contained a circular dirt track occasionally used for horse racing.
sentences.zh: 这片开阔的场地周围环绕着干草、树木和灌木，里面有一条偶尔用于赛马的圆形土路。

sentences.en: Although the field was surrounded by main roads, cars didn't usually access the area, making it a popular place for children to play.
sentences.zh: 尽管这片场地四周环绕着主要道路，但平时没有车辆进入，因此成了孩子们玩耍的热门地点。

sentences.en: Huy Pedru did as his mother told, waving goodbye as he happily pedalled off on his bike towards the field.
sentences.zh: 乌伊·佩德鲁听从了母亲的话，挥手告别，开心地骑着自行车朝空地驶去。

sentences.en: Nearly four hours later, as 6pm approached,
sentences.zh: 将近四个小时后，临近下午6点，

sentences.en: Philomena and Manuel received a phone call from Huy Pedru's tutor, informing them that he had not turned up for his 5 o'clock lesson.
sentences.zh: 菲洛梅娜和曼努埃尔接到了乌伊·佩德鲁家教的电话，通知他们他没有去上5点的课。

sentences.en: This came as a surprise, as he had never missed a tutoring session before.
sentences.zh: 这让人感到意外，因为他以前从未缺席过家教课。

sentences.en: The 11-year-old suffered from epilepsy that required daily medication, and fear soon grew that he may have suffered an attack.
sentences.zh: 这个11岁的男孩患有癫痫，需要每天服药，人们很快开始担心他可能发病了。

sentences.en: If untreated, a seizure could cause severe brain damage or worse.
sentences.zh: 如果得不到治疗，癫痫发作可能会导致严重的脑损伤甚至更严重的后果。

sentences.en: A search party was quickly formed, and local residents were asked if they had seen the boy.
sentences.zh: 搜寻队伍迅速组建起来，并向当地居民打听是否见过这个男孩。

sentences.en: A neighbour revealed that at around 3pm, they had found Huy Pedru's bicycle amongst the bushes in the vacant field behind Philomena's office.
sentences.zh: 一名邻居透露，下午3点左右，他们在菲洛梅娜办公室后方的空地灌木丛中发现了乌伊·佩德鲁的自行车。

sentences.en: His family contacted the National Public Guard,
sentences.zh: 他的家人联系了国民警卫队，

sentences.en: Portugal's military police who were responsible for civil law enforcement, and a wide-scale search was initiated.
sentences.zh: 也就是负责治安执法的葡萄牙宪兵部队，并随即展开了大规模搜查。

sentences.en: The police combed the streets of Lozada with assistance from local firemen, residents, and specially trained police dogs, but failed to uncover any other sign of the young boy.
sentences.zh: 在当地消防员、居民和特种警犬的协助下，警方对洛扎达的街道进行了搜查，但未能发现这个小男孩的任何其他踪迹。

sentences.en: Three local boys came forward to report that as they were playing football together in the vacant field earlier in the afternoon,
sentences.zh: 三名当地男孩站出来报告称，当天下午早些时候，当他们在空地上一起踢足球时，

sentences.en: Huy Pedru arrived on his bike and joined them.
sentences.zh: 乌伊·佩德鲁骑着自行车赶来加入了他们。

sentences.en: At around 3pm, a black vehicle drove onto the racetrack and pulled up alongside Huy Pedru, who chatted with the male driver,
sentences.zh: 下午3点左右，一辆黑色汽车开进赛道，停在乌伊·佩德鲁身旁，他与男司机交谈了一番，

sentences.en: before gesturing to his friends that he wouldn't be playing with them.
sentences.zh: 然后向同伴打手势说他不和大家一起玩了。

sentences.en: He climbed into the car, leaving his bicycle behind.
sentences.zh: 他上了车，把自行车留在了原地。

sentences.en: The children identified the driver as 22-year-old Afonso Dias, who they said had been fixated on Huy Pedru over the past couple of weeks, constantly asking where he was,
sentences.zh: 孩子们认出司机是22岁的阿方索·迪亚什，他们说迪亚什在过去几周里一直盯着乌伊·佩德鲁，经常打听他在哪里、

sentences.en: who he was with, and what his upcoming plans were.
sentences.zh: 他和谁在一起以及接下来有什么计划。

sentences.en: Huy Pedru's younger sister, Carina, also recalled that earlier that year,
sentences.zh: 乌伊·佩德鲁的妹妹卡琳娜也回忆说，今年早些时候，

sentences.en: Dias had taken photographs of her and her brother, something he'd never done before.
sentences.zh: 迪亚什曾给她和哥哥拍过照片，这是他以前从未做过的事。

sentences.en: Several other witnesses also reported having seen Huy Pedru speaking to Afonso Dias at the field that afternoon.
sentences.zh: 其他几位目击者也报告说，当天下午在空地上看到过乌伊·佩德鲁与阿方索·迪亚什说话。

sentences.en: Dias was sighted driving a black Fiat Uno that belonged to his brother, who confirmed he had loaned the vehicle to Dias so he could take it for its annual roadworthy test,
sentences.zh: 有人看到迪亚什开着一辆属于他哥哥的黑色菲亚特乌诺，他哥哥证实确实把车借给了迪亚什，好让他去做年度道路适宜性检测，

sentences.en: a mandatory practice in Portugal for vehicles over eight years old.
sentences.zh: 这是葡萄牙对车龄超过八年的车辆的强制性规定。

sentences.en: However, records revealed Dias didn't attend the scheduled inspection.
sentences.zh: 然而，记录显示迪亚什并未参加预定的检测。

sentences.en: Police quickly located Dias.
sentences.zh: 警方迅速找到了迪亚什。

sentences.en: Huy Pedru wasn't with him, and he claimed not to know where the missing boy was.
sentences.zh: 乌伊·佩德鲁不在他身边，他声称自己不知道失踪的男孩在哪里。

sentences.en: Dias was taken to the Lozada police station for further questioning, where he denied giving Huy Pedru a ride, claiming he had only seen the boy for five minutes,
sentences.zh: 迪亚什被带到洛扎达警察局接受进一步盘问，在那里他否认曾载过乌伊·佩德鲁，声称他只在下午1点50分到1点55分之间

sentences.en: between 1.50 and 1.55pm.
sentences.zh: 见过这个男孩五分钟。

sentences.en: After this brief encounter, he drove alone to the nearby city of Pakosh de Ferhera, located about 15 minutes west, where he parked outside a pharmacy.
sentences.zh: 这短暂的相遇之后，他独自开车前往位于西边约15分钟路程的附近城市帕科什-德费雷拉，并将车停在一家药店门外。

sentences.en: He sat in the car for a while before walking around town, looking at the shop windows.
sentences.zh: 他在车里坐了一会儿，然后步行在城里闲逛，看着商店的橱窗。

sentences.en: He then drove the short distance to his girlfriend's home in the nearby town of Friamondji, arriving at 6.45pm.
sentences.zh: 接着，他驱车一小段路来到了附近弗里亚蒙迪镇的女友家，于下午6点45分抵达。

sentences.en: There, he received a phone call from his sister informing that Huy Pedru was missing.
sentences.zh: 在那里，他接到妹妹的电话，被告知乌伊·佩德鲁失踪了。

sentences.en: Huy Pedru's distraught grandfather,
sentences.zh: 乌伊·佩德鲁心烦意乱的外祖父

sentences.en: Jose, was also at the police station awaiting news.
sentences.zh: 何塞当时也在警察局等待消息。

sentences.en: In a desperate bid to locate his grandson, he confronted Dias and offered him anything he wanted to disclose Huy Pedru's whereabouts.
sentences.zh: 为了急切地找到外孙，他与迪亚什对质，并承诺只要他说出乌伊·佩德鲁的下落，想要什么都可以。

sentences.en: Dias began to cry, insisting he didn't know where the 11-year-old was.
sentences.zh: 迪亚什开始哭泣，坚称自己不知道这个11岁的男孩在哪里。

sentences.en: Then, all of a sudden, he gave police anonymous warning, telling them Huy Pedru could already be very far away and they should, quote,
sentences.zh: 然后，突然之间，他向警方发出了神秘的警告，告诉他们乌伊·佩德鲁可能已经去得很远了，他们应该——引述他的话——

sentences.en: close the borders.
sentences.zh: 关闭边境。

sentences.en: Dias was also accosted by Huy Pedru's young cousin,
sentences.zh: 迪亚什还遭到乌伊·佩德鲁小表弟

sentences.en: Joao Andrei, who began telling officers about an encounter the two boys had with Dias the previous day.
sentences.zh: 若昂·安德雷的质问，安德雷开始向警官们讲述这两个男孩前一天与迪亚什相遇的经历。

sentences.en: Dias warned him to shut up, but Andrei was undeterred, explaining that Dias had invited them to, quote, go to the prostitutes.
sentences.zh: 迪亚什警告他闭嘴，但安德雷没有退缩，解释说迪亚什曾邀请他们去——引述原话——“找妓女”。

sentences.en: Dias allegedly told the young boys to meet him at the field near the driving school the following day, where he would pick them up.
sentences.zh: 据称迪亚什告诉这两个小男孩第二天在驾校附近的空地见，他会去接他们。

sentences.en: When March 4 arrived,
sentences.zh: 当3月4日到来时，

sentences.en: Andrei's mother wouldn't let him leave the house, so he missed the meeting.
sentences.zh: 安德雷的母亲不让他出门，所以他错过了这次会面。

sentences.en: A local firefighter named Maria was one of many who witnessed Huy Pedru get into a black car at the field that afternoon.
sentences.zh: 一名叫玛丽亚的当地消防员是当天下午在空地上目睹乌伊·佩德鲁上了一辆黑色汽车的众多证人之一。

sentences.en: When she visited the local police station to provide a report, she ran in to Alfonso Dias and recognised him as the car's driver and informed officers of her discovery.
sentences.zh: 当她前往当地警察局做笔录时，遇到了阿方索·迪亚什，认出他就是汽车司机，并向警官们通报了这一发现。

sentences.en: This rattled Dias, who confronted Maria at the fire station following their encounter.
sentences.zh: 这让迪亚什感到惊慌，在他们碰面后，他在消防局质问了玛丽亚。

sentences.en: He was visibly worried and bombarded her with questions pertaining to the ongoing investigation, including whether she knew what his car looked like.
sentences.zh: 他显得忧心忡忡，并抛出一连串与正在进行的调查相关的问题，包括她是否知道他的车长什么样。

sentences.en: Meanwhile,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，

sentences.en: Huy Pedru's disappearance had made local news, with reports describing him as 4 foot 11 inches tall, weighing approximately 45 kilograms, with short brown hair, dark eyes,
sentences.zh: 乌伊·佩德鲁失踪的消息已经登上当地新闻，报道描述他身高4英尺11英寸（约150厘米），体重约45公斤，留着短棕发、深色眼睛，

sentences.en: and suntanned skin.
sentences.zh: 皮肤晒得黝黑。

sentences.en: This description was accompanied by a picture of him flashing a smile that revealed his distinctively large front teeth.
sentences.zh: 这段描述配有一张他咧嘴微笑的照片，露出了他标志性的大门牙。

sentences.en: A local sex worker named Alcina recognised the boy in the photograph and immediately contacted authorities.
sentences.zh: 当地一名性工作者阿尔西娜认出了照片中的男孩，并立即联系了当局。

sentences.en: Please do not forget it.
sentences.zh: 请千万不要忘记这一点。

sentences.en: Never give up.
sentences.zh: 永远不要放弃。

sentences.en: In 2018, a video of a homeless Portuguese man circulating on social media caught the attention of national news outlets.
sentences.zh: 2018年，一段流传于社交媒体上的关于一名无家可归的葡萄牙男子的视频引起了国家新闻媒体的注意。

sentences.en: The bearded man was lean with tanned skin, had dark hair and eyes, and bore other striking similarities to Hui Pedru.
sentences.zh: 这个蓄着胡子的男子身材消瘦、皮肤晒黑，有着深色的头发和眼睛，并且与惠·佩德鲁有着其他惊人的相似之处。

sentences.en: He said his name was Pedru, and that he was 30 years old, which roughly matched the age Hui Pedru would have been at the time.
sentences.zh: 他说自己名叫佩德鲁，今年30岁，这与惠·佩德鲁当时的年龄大致相符。

sentences.en: However, he was born and raised in Almada, a city located in southern Portugal, approximately 350 kilometres south of
sentences.zh: 然而，他出生并在阿尔马达长大，这座城市位于葡萄牙南部，大约在

sentences.en: Lozada.
sentences.zh: 洛萨达以南350公里处。

sentences.en: The video was shared thousands of times and sent to the Teixeira-Mendoza family.
sentences.zh: 这段视频被转发了数千次，并被发送给了特谢拉-门多萨一家。

sentences.en: Manuel noted the man in the footage shared some physical characteristics to his son,
sentences.zh: 曼努埃尔指出，视频中的男子与他的儿子确实有一些共同的身体特征，

sentences.en: including large front teeth, but also noticed obvious differences, such as the shape of his ears.
sentences.zh: 包括显眼的大门牙，但也发现了明显的不同之处，比如耳朵的形状。

sentences.en: The video was sent to the authorities for further analysis, and the judicial police managed to identify the individual.
sentences.zh: 该视频已被送交有关当局进行进一步分析，司法警察随后成功确认了该男子的身份。

sentences.en: It was not Hui Pedru, but a man called Pedru Hebelu.
sentences.zh: 不是路易·佩德鲁，而是一个名叫佩德鲁·海贝鲁的男子。

sentences.en: In January 2019,
Filomena was interviewed by Portuguese television host Cristina Ferreira, during which she discussed how the search for her son had sent her into the dark world of pedophilia.
sentences.zh: 菲洛梅娜接受了葡萄牙电视主持人克里斯蒂娜·费雷拉的采访，在采访中她谈到寻找儿子的经历如何将她引入了黑暗的恋童癖世界。

sentences.en: She said she had cried so much that she had no more tears left, but made it clear that she did not mourn for her son, as she believed he was alive.
sentences.zh: 她说她哭得太厉害，眼泪都流干了，但她明确表示她并没有为儿子服丧，因为她坚信他还活着。

sentences.en: In response to her doctor's recommendation to place a memorial stone in Hui Pedru's bedroom,
sentences.zh: 针对医生建议在路易·佩德鲁的卧室里放一块纪念石，

sentences.en: Filomena said,
sentences.zh: 菲洛梅娜说：

sentences.en: Many continue to suspect that Afonso Dias was involved in Hui Pedru's disappearance, with the general belief being that he took the child to sex workers to lose his virginity in
sentences.zh: 许多人仍然怀疑阿方索·迪亚斯参与了路易·佩德鲁的失踪案，普遍的看法是，他带这个孩子去找性工作者破处，

sentences.en: preparation for selling him to a pedophile ring.
sentences.zh: 以此为将他贩卖给恋童癖团伙做准备。

sentences.en: There is evidence to prove the Wonderland Club had roots in Portugal, with at least one member living in the country at the time the group was exposed.
sentences.zh: 有证据证明“仙境俱乐部”在葡萄牙有根基，在该组织被曝光时，至少有一名成员居住在该国。

sentences.en: Filomena believes Dias may have been a victim of blackmail, who was forced to play a role in her son's disappearance, but remained silent out of fear.
sentences.zh: 菲洛梅娜认为迪亚斯可能是敲诈勒索的受害者，被迫在她儿子的失踪案中扮演了某个角色，但出于恐惧一直保持沉默。

sentences.en: The Teixeira Mendoza family and the Portuguese public remain hopeful that Dias will one day break his silence and reveal the truth,
sentences.zh: 特谢拉·门多萨家族和葡萄牙公众仍然希望迪亚斯有一天能打破沉默，揭露真相，

sentences.en: with Manuel urging him to imagine what it would be like to live without his own child for so many years.
sentences.zh: 曼努埃尔敦促他设身处地想象一下，这么多年没有自己的孩子生活会是什么样子。

sentences.en: On Hui Pedru's 32nd birthday, Filomena wrote a message that read,
sentences.zh: 在路易·佩德鲁32岁生日那天，菲洛梅娜写了一条信息：

sentences.en: Son, I remember you in a mixture of emotions, joy and sadness.
sentences.zh: 儿子，我带着复杂的情感——喜悦与悲伤——在想念你。

sentences.en: Joy because I had you and you were part of me.
sentences.zh: 喜悦是因为我拥有过你，你曾是我的一部分。

sentences.en: Sadness because they took you and I did not have the opportunity to see you grow from the age of 11.
sentences.zh: 悲伤是因为他们夺走了你，我没有机会看着你从11岁长大。

sentences.en: On this day, I hope you will remember how much you have made me happy.
sentences.zh: 在这个日子里，我希望你能记住你曾带给我多少快乐。

sentences.en: I do not want to think I will never see you again.
sentences.zh: 我不想去想我再也见不到你了。

sentences.en: Today is your day, January 28, 2019.
sentences.zh: 今天是你的日子，2019年1月28日。

sentences.en: I await your arrival.
sentences.zh: 我等待着你的归来。

sentences.en: Kiss and hug.
sentences.zh: 亲亲抱抱。

sentences.en: Mother.
sentences.zh: 母亲。
